author: michaelkrymski
summary: Demonstrate real LiDAR with simulated three-column responses
details: Add local Demo tab with per-column 1.2 m visual response threshold and explicit Unknown/simulation labels; source snapshot already clears on lifecycle/recency loss. No motors, network or movement guidance.
validation: Seven strict Mac tests and signed physical-iPhone UI test passed without skips. Actual 0.92/0.62/0.84 m snapshot triggered visual Near responses; Stop cleared all. No controlled target accuracy/mapping acceptance.
